what: Claude: filed REQUEST_CLAUDE-20260916-002 asking Astra to find the disk regression. Evidence: a fresh 8 GiB NexusFS format was 8516 ms at 229b159 and has been ~33 s in every run since (32681, 32688, 32056, 33403). The driver's own counters say the work is identical -- 131242 sectors written in both the fast and slow run, interrupts within 0.3% -- so it is request latency, not request count. Window is 229b159..b2fa8fb; I read all three commits and the -drive/-device lines are byte-identical, no profile change. My hypothesis, untested: host NTFS fragmentation of the 8 GiB image on a volume that is 88% full. I am keeping off the disk path while this is with Astra.
